caption: The drawing depicts a metal tool consisting of a cylindrical handle attached to a triangular frame, which supports two parallel, horizontally aligned discs with large, jagged, saw-like edges. The discs are positioned next to each other, held on either end of the frame, and create a series of sharp, angular points. The entire tool is rendered in shades of gray, giving a metallic appearance, and is set against a plain, off-white background. There is a faint signature or writing near the bottom right corner of the image. The tool is shown at an angle, allowing both the handle and the double-disc blade arrangement to be visible.
title: Oven Scraper
